findings.title: Spend double-source divergence
findings.description: channels[].spend and transactions[].amount are independent stores both representing channel spend. Dashboard uses getTotalSpent(transactions) while ChannelAnalytics sums channels[].spend. They agree at seed state (both ₹1900) but will silently diverge if a transaction is added without updating the channel's spend field.
findings.action: Derive channel spend exclusively from the transactions array, or update channels[].spend atomically whenever ADD_TRANSACTION fires.
